//: Original Prologue content, not CDDA's: what anything that rots turns into. One stack, counted by weight — one unit is the item's own weight; what is left under a unit is lost. rules.json 'spoilage' holds the dials, farming.json its worth as fertilizer.

description: Whatever this was, it has gone over: a dark, sour heap no one should eat. Dug into a bed it still feeds the soil.
